limits: HOENN_TEAMS parts 6 and 7.9-7.13. Fill-ins (the docs give none): names, the interview answers, the talk lines, report lines past the two written, Zinnia's window lines, the admins' standing orders, gadget effects (they help missions, not the player's own map), and the success formula's weights.

ranks.name: Flyer
ranks.gains: Two Pokémon; can go on any mission.

ranks.name: Wingleader
ranks.gains: Three Pokémon; leads a squad; gets a nickname.

ranks.name: Admin
ranks.gains: Four Pokémon with a chosen ace; standing orders while you're away.

origins.name: Ex-Magma
why: You let me go. I owe.
I read the last page. Nobody else would.
I'm done digging for a man who won't look up.

answers.why: Because you looked at the readings. Maxie never did.
answers.did: Fenced a hot spring. Moved an old woman out of it. She called me dear.
answers.wont: I won't go back down the drill. Don't ask me to.

origins.name: Ex-Aqua
why: The tide took my nerve. You didn't laugh.
Archie talks about the sea. I'd rather somebody who listens to it.
Heard you pay, and you don't sink boats.

answers.why: You don't wear a bandana and you don't shout. That's two things.
answers.did: Charged ferries a tax. One of them carried schoolchildren.
answers.wont: I won't hold anybody under. Not even them.

origins.name: Townsfolk
why: You helped my street. I can carry things.
Two gangs in town already. Figured I'd join the one that isn't.

answers.why: You stopped on the road for us. Nobody stops.
answers.did: Nothing. That's the point. I did nothing for anyone and I'd like to stop.
answers.wont: I won't leave my mum's town to burn. If it's that or the job, it's that.

origins.name: Ranger
why: The wild ones are getting caught in the middle.
I've a patrol and no backing.
The Rangers sent me to watch you. I'd rather help.

answers.why: Because the Pokémon on Route 119 can't vote.
answers.did: Counted Castform for the Institute. Then the Institute stopped answering.
answers.wont: I won't take anything from the wild that it needs.

origins.name: Drifter
why: There was a kite. I followed it.
I don't stay anywhere. I'll stay a while.

answers.did: A bit of everything. Some of it I'd tell you about.
answers.wont: I won't be bored. If it's boring I'll go.

origins.name: Draconid
why: Zinnia said you'd do. That's rare.
The old songs say somebody stands under the sky. Might as well be us.
My grandmother kept the Pillar. I'd like to keep something.

answers.why: Zinnia says the sky's been waiting. I believe her, mostly.
answers.did: Learned the songs. All of them. Nobody asks for them.
answers.wont: I won't call the dragon for a quarrel. Never for a quarrel.

traits.name: Medic
traits.text: A failed mission doesn't hurt the squad.

traits.name: Negotiator
traits.text: Can end a mission by talking.

flaws.name: Hot-Headed
flaws.text: May turn a Quiet mission into a fight (−10 on Quiet).

flaws.name: Homesick
flaws.text: Loyalty −1 each region away from Hoenn.

flaws.name: Old Loyalties
flaws.text: Won't go on missions against their old team.

flaws.name: Glory-Hound
flaws.text: Loyalty −1 if not promoted in two stages.

archetypes.name: The Flock
archetypes.perk: Squads move one node farther (missions take a node less).

archetypes.name: The Stormfront
archetypes.perk: Missions ignore weather penalties (+5 on every mission).

archetypes.name: The Wyrms
archetypes.perk: +1 Skill on combat missions; hiring costs +25%.

archetypes.name: The Watchers
archetypes.perk: Shows the other teams' next Operation (Watch missions always succeed).

archetypes.name: The Strays
archetypes.perk: Loyalty +1 for everyone; Skill varies wildly.

archetypes.name: The Pack
archetypes.perk: Squads of three get +1 Skill; a lone grunt gets −1.

rooms.name: Roost
rooms.line: Somebody's hung their scarf on every peg. There are pegs to spare.

rooms.name: Map Room
rooms.text: Both teams' sites shown on the Hoenn map.
rooms.line: Red pins and blue pins. Somebody's added a green one, very small, on the base.

rooms.name: Infirmary
rooms.line: A Chansey asleep on the spare bed. Nobody has the heart to move it.

rooms.name: Workshop
rooms.text: Gadgets: gliders, weather balloons, signal kites.
rooms.line: Glue, string, and a glider with one wing. "It's fine. It's the other one that matters."

rooms.name: Mess Hall
rooms.text: Loyalty +1 for all, once per region.
rooms.line: Stew. Somebody's arguing about the stew. Everyone's eating it.

rooms.name: The Long Window
rooms.text: A place to stand and look out. No mechanical effect.
rooms.line: The whole of the sky, and nobody in it yet.

gadgets.name: Signal kites
gadgets.text: +10 on Parley missions; captured grunts are found faster.

missions.name: Rescue
missions.lose: a grunt's Pokémon hurt for a stage

where.text: Evacuate a village below a Magma drill.
Get a stranded family off a sandbar before the tide Aqua's pumping.
Bring the bathers out before the spring boils.

missions.name: Sabotage
missions.lose: Heat gained, a grunt's Pokémon hurt

where.text: Foul a Magma bore with gravel.
Loosen the chocks on an Aqua submarine.
Run food to a cut-off town.
Carry medicine up to the tree houses.
Bring lamps to the miners' families.
Carry a message to a lieutenant.
Carry a message to a lieutenant.

kind.name: Kind
kind.text: Costs Funds; raises Loyalty and Reputation.

rescue: We got them all out. {mate} carried the old man. He wouldn't stop thanking the Pokémon.
We got the food through! I got bit by a Poochyena! It's ours now! Can it be ours?
sabotage: Pump's jammed. Nobody saw us. {mate} fell in. They're fine. They're embarrassed.
Done. It'll take them a week. I left the bolts in a neat pile, out of spite.
watch: Followed all day. Wrote it down. They're moving next on {op}.
Sat in a hedge for a stage. Saw everything. Want my notes or the short version?
supply: Delivered. They gave us soup. {mate} had three.
Medicine's up the trees. They let us use the rope bridge. Never again.
raid: Payroll's ours. They'll be counting for a week. So will we.
Got it. Got chased. Got away. In that order.
parley: Message delivered. They read it twice. They didn't burn it.
They listened. They didn't say yes. They didn't say no, either.

rescue: We couldn't get everyone. {mate}'s Pokémon took a hit getting the last kid out.
Too late. We tried. I'm sorry.
sabotage: They had a guard on it. We ran. {mate}'s limping.
It's still pumping. I'm still wet.
watch: Lost them in the fog. They saw us, I think.
supply: Lost the cart on the bridge. The town's still hungry.
Robbed on the road. By grunts. Theirs, not ours.
raid: Bad. They took {mate}. We have to go back.
parley: They tore it up in front of us.
They wouldn't see us. They sent a grunt to say so.

lines: "I'm counting on you. Don't make me wrong."
talk.yes: They stand a bit straighter. "...All right. All right, then."
talk.no: They nod, and it doesn't land. Maybe another day.

cracked.greedy: The pay's thin and the work isn't.
cracked.hot-headed: We keep backing off. I didn't sign up to back off.
cracked.homesick: It's a long way from home, this.
cracked.old-loyalties: Some of them were my friends. Still are.

orders.name: Keep everyone safe
orders.text: No grunt is captured on a failed mission while you're away.

orders.name: Keep the pressure on
orders.text: Renown +1 a stage, and Heat +1 with both teams.

window.none: "Nice view. You should stand here more. People think better standing up."
window.hire: "New face. Do they know what we are yet? Do we?"
window.promote: "You pinned a badge on someone. They'll remember the hands, not the badge."
window.dismiss: "You let one go. The others watched how."
window.dispatch: "Sending them out without you. That's the hard part. It doesn't get easier."
window.win: "Good news from the board? Don't get used to it."
window.lose: "A bad report. Read it twice. Then put it down."
window.build: "More rooms. The more rooms, the more there is to lose. I'm not saying don't."
window.doctrine: "You told them what to carry. Now they'll carry it whether it suits them or not."
window.talk: "You talked to one of them. Properly. Good."
